title: HelpDesk 2.6.6 — Ticket Logging Reliability
summary: Improved delivery of ticket closure transcripts and deployment update announcements.
changed: Fixed update announcements exceeding Discord's 2,000-character message limit while retaining the deployment marker.
Added a channel fetch fallback when the ticket transcript channel is missing from cache.
Added a transcript embed fallback when an attachment upload fails.
Added clearer diagnostic warnings for unavailable log and update channels.
Updated the /panel and DM support notice to explain private DM-based ticket handling.
